title: VEON 2026 Capital Markets Day Content is Now Available on Demand
body_markdown:
20 Nov 2026


#### VEON 2026 Capital Markets Day Content is Now Available on Demand


*Full replay, presentation materials, and photo highlights from the November 16 event at Nasdaq MarketSite are available at*[veoncmd.com](https://www.veoncmd.com/en)


**New York and Dubai, November 20, 2026 –** VEON Ltd. (Nasdaq: VEON), a global digital operator, today announced that the full recording, presentation materials and photo highlights of its 2026 Capital Markets Day are now available on demand at[veoncmd.com](https://www.veoncmd.com/en) .


The event took place on November 16, 2026, at the Nasdaq MarketSite in New York. The day opened with VEON’s management team ringing the Nasdaq Opening Bell to mark the 30th anniversary of the company’s US listing.


More than 50 external investors and analysts attended the Capital Markets Day that followed in person, and more than 70 further external participants joined the live webcast.


Under the vision “VEON 2030: A Better Life for All,” the company’s management team presented the Group’s strategy and its 2030 financial framework. This framework builds towards the following targets:


-


Growth: 12–15% organic annual growth in USD revenue and EBITDA, 2026 to 2030


-


Earnings and cash flow: earnings per share and free cash flow growing faster than revenue


-


Shareholder returns: at least USD 200 million annually, through share buybacks and cancellation


-


Balance sheet discipline: net leverage at or below 1.5x, excluding leases


VEON also aspires to increase its mix of digital services to approximately 50% of Group revenue by 2030, from 27.2% in the 3Q26, by combining organic growth with selective acquisitions. The Group’s 2030 growth target above is on an organic basis.


Kaan Terzioğlu, Group CEO at VEON said: “We were delighted by the strong engagement from investors and analysts, both in the room and online, at our Capital Markets Day 2026. During the event, we set out how telecom remains the foundation of our business, but it is not the destination. A year ago, digital services made up approximately a fifth of our revenue. Today it’s more than a quarter, and climbing every quarter we report. We’ve paired that growth with real capital discipline: raised guidance, an active share buyback, and a stronger balance sheet funding what comes next. For anyone who could not join us, the full presentations are now available, and we look forward to continuing the conversation with you as we build towards our next phase of growth.”


**Explore the full Capital Markets Day at**[veoncmd.com](https://www.veoncmd.com/en)


Visitors can access the full presentations and Q&A sessions, session materials, event highlights, and the VEON CEO’s AI Digital Twin - an interactive experience designed to help analysts and investors explore VEON’s published strategy and CMD content.


**About VEON**
VEON is a digital operator that provides connectivity and digital services to over 150 million connectivity users and more than 221 million digital customers. Operating across five countries - that are home to 550 million consumers, more than 6% of the world's population, VEON is transforming lives through technology-driven services that empower individuals and drive economic growth. VEON is listed on NASDAQ. For more information, visit[www.veon.com](https://www.veon.com/) .
